detail.longDescription: IBM has open-sourced Granite Speech 5.0 2B, a 2B-parameter speech model for transcription and translation in six languages under Apache 2.0. It ranks second on the Open ASR Leaderboard with a 5.68% average English word error rate, and adds keyword biasing for up to 2,000 terms. It runs on GPU, Apple Silicon or local CPUs. https://www. marktechpost.com/2026/10/22/ib m-granite-speech-5-0-2b-release/ # AIagent # AI # GenAI # AIresearch
